classification: dirty-tree signed-worker diagnostic; not release or five-family qualification
signing_scope: Apple Development signed worker bundle; parent recorded by executable SHA-256
implementation: Native user-edit provenance is distinct from dirty value and sensitivity. Shared tooShort/tooLong state drives validation, CSS, submission and OIL observations.
Text-control input paths normalize line breaks and enforce maxlength in UTF-16 units without splitting a surrogate pair; numeric input excludes maxlength.
Textarea defaultValue reads direct child text; default and dirty live values stay distinct, with pristine defaults following child mutation and reset.
Length reflection, textarea textLength and legacy null-to-empty value conversion.
Keyboard/paste helpers, native OIL typing and focused text-control editing commands use native edit state rather than deriving user provenance from synthetic events.
Native select-event tasks keep detached targets rooted, run asynchronously with microtask checkpoints, and are discarded on realm retirement; page setTimeout is not consulted.
User changes commit once on blur/focus transition; reset clears pending commit state.

task_limits.scope: Per-realm queue and bounded native host drain, not an agent-wide scheduling qualification.

tests.scope: Native default/dirty/provenance, UTF-16 bounds, shared validation/style/submission, queued/trusted select events, poisoned page timers, single blur commit, reset, queue exhaustion and retired-queue rejection.
tests.timing_scope: Regression elapsed times with overlapping work; not performance qualification.

wpt.scope: Selected relevant suites, not a full-WPT baseline.

oil.scope: OIL actions type and submit; a separate stdin-controlled server oracle checks zero POSTs for blocked input, exactly one receipt after recovery, ordered field values, authorized uploads and receipt reload. UTF-16 length is independently enforced by the server. Contract v5 changes constraints and adds three cases; it is not an identical-fixture comparison with v4.

smoke.scope: Existing observation/error smoke, not independent full-workflow qualification.

intermediate_candidate.fixes_before_final: Legacy null conversion, select tasks and change-on-blur. The 22 not-run assertions followed the queued-select timeout; they are not claimed as 22 separate engine defects. All intermediate passing assertion identities retained.

remaining: Broader multi-step forms and independently persisted shopping, research, authenticated SaaS and booking outcomes.
Representative framework applications, repeated concurrency/context-isolation checks.
Remaining browser architecture packages: initial connected-window ownership, per-document routing, worker-agent execution and upstream automation.
Full Core WPT, remaining editing/input semantics including badInput, and clean-source security/performance/Linux qualification.
